title: You`re Infinite
author: Renette D Souza
text:
You hold it all in the palm of your hands
The ocean storms, the desert sands
The ground beneath and the skies above
You hold in your heart perpetual love.

Eternal, omnipotent and divine
You exist since the very begining of time
Your love shines through and multiplies
Like the multitudinous stars in the skies

Cause you`re infinite, without boundaries
The unending waves that rule the seas
Countless like dandelions, blown in the breeze
Innumerable like the leaves of the evergreen trees.

You surround me, are all around me
All majestic, exalted and sublime
Diverse in this unending universe
Transcending the portals of time.

I`ll die and be reborn a hundred times
Yet I know you will always be by my side
For you exist and I always find you
In that little voice deep inside.

A voice that speaks only truthfully
Fill our lives with a sweet melody
You are infinity, the key to eternity
The door that opens and sets us free.
